theater: 河北雄州瓦橋關與易水南岸

battle.name: 瓦橋關之戰
battle.theater: 河北雄州瓦橋關與易水南岸
battle.brief: 乾亨二年（980）冬，遼景宗耶律賢親征南下，圍宋邊關瓦橋關（今河北雄縣西南），破關陣斬守將張師，渡易水追宋軍至莫州境內。卡面的羅馬弩砲並不在此戰場，它所代表的扭力蓄力、單發重箭技術，在關城上是宋軍的床弩與蹶張弓，在攻城一方則是靠人馬硬攻的遼軍。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 九八〇年冬天，這場戰爭發生在宋、遼兩國交界的最前沿：河北雄州歸義縣（後改歸信縣，即今河北雄縣）西南的瓦橋關，以及關南拒馬河（古稱易水）兩側的平原地帶。交戰的一方是遼國。皇帝耶律賢御駕親征，大軍以契丹騎兵為骨幹，漢軍、渤海軍與奚、靼諸部為輔，配以固定的攻城營具與隨軍車帳；南京留守耶律休哥總攏前線兵權，節度使蕭干、將軍耶律赫德分掌營務與巡邏，糧秣主要由幽州、中京一線沿河道轉運，人馬則自備乾糧與馬群。另一方是北宋。瓦橋關是宋初三關（瓦橋、淤口、益津）中最靠幽州的一座關城，守軍由河北諸鎮屯兵與關城守軍組成，統兵序列上受幽州行營都部署劉遇、壕砦都監田欽祚、威塞軍節度使曹翰、登州防禦使趙延溥等節制；宋太宗趙光義坐鎮開封，只在戰後遣河陽節度使崔彥進出任關南兵馬督部署。地理上，三關四周是白洋淀以南的冀中平原，無大山大河可守，只靠土築關城、邊寨與拒馬硬撐，宋廷因此把此地視為北方藩籬；而遼廷則視之為南進河北、中原的跳板。
countriesEn: The fighting of the winter of 980 took place on the very front line between Song and Liao: at Waqiao Pass in the southwest of the seat of Xiongzhou prefecture, Guiyi county (later renamed Guixin, present-day Xiong County, Hebei), and on the open plain on both sides of the Juma River, called Yishui in the older sources. One belligerent was the Liao state. Emperor Yelü Xian led the campaign in person, the army having the Khitan horse archers as its backbone, with Han Chinese, Bohai and Xi and Di contingents in support, together with fixed siege equipment and wagon-borne camps. The commander of the front, Yelü Xiuge, who held the Nanjing (Youzhou) garrison, concentrated the operational command, while the circuit commissioner Xiao Gan and the general Yelü Hede took charge of camp discipline and patrols. Supplies came mainly by water transport from Youzhou and the Central Capital, the men and horses carrying their own rations and fodder. The other belligerent was Northern Song. Waqiao Pass was the easternmost of Song's three passes, Waqiao, Yuku and Yijin, and the one closest to Youzhou. Its garrison combined the troops quartered in the Hebei circuits with the pass guard, and in the chain of command answered to such officers as Liu Yu, chief commander of the Youzhou field camp, Tian Qinzuo, master of the stockades, Cao Han, military governor of Weisai, and Zhao Yanpu, defense commissioner of Dengzhou. Emperor Zhao Guangyi stayed at Bianjing and only after the fighting sent Cui Yanjin, military governor of Heyang, to take charge of the armies south of the pass. Geographically the three passes stood on the flat Jizhong plain south of Baiyang Lake, with no mountains and no great rivers to hold, and rested on rammed-earth walls, frontier forts and wooden barricades alone. For that reason the Song court counted the line as its northern bulwark, while the Liao court treated it as the springboard from which to march into Hebei and the Central Plain.
people: 遼景宗耶律賢是這一戰的絕對主角。他先命巫師拜祭天地與兵神，又令大軍祭旗鼓，十日後抵達幽州，隨後御駕率兵圍攻瓦橋關，戰至易水之役時親自督戰。他做過一件極為細節的安排：自乘的白馬在陣前太顯眼，容易被宋軍弓弩集火，便與耶律休哥互換坐騎，把那匹容易被認出的馬留在自己身上，而讓休哥騎上他的馬衝鋒。遼將耶律休哥是此役的實際主戰者，他先在關東佈防，親率大軍擊退出關反擊的宋軍，陣斬守將張師；其後率精騎渡易水，大敗宋軍，追奔至莫州境內，生擒多名宋軍將領。蕭干與耶律赫德守在營中，擊退了宋軍的夜襲。另一端，宋太宗趙光義的反應可說是被動：他有巡邊雄州的打算卻未成行，聽信前方「擊潰遼軍萬餘、陣斬三千餘」的傳報後才下詔巡邊、派崔彥進督關南兵馬；事後他改派在雁門之戰中令遼軍心寒的楊業為雲州觀察使，原擬推進幽州的計劃則被翰林學士李昉、扈蒙勸止。瓦橋關守將張師是宋方唯一留下姓名的將領，他試圖突圍出關求援，卻在關東被截殺。
peopleEn: Emperor Jingzong of Liao, Yelü Xian, is the central figure of this campaign. He first had his shaman offer sacrifice to Heaven, Earth and the god of war, and had the army perform the rite of the flag and the drums; ten days later he reached Youzhou, and then led his troops in person to surround Waqiao Pass, taking charge of the battle himself in the fighting on the Yishui. He showed attention to the smallest detail there: the white horse he rode himself was too conspicuous in the line and could easily be picked out by Song bowmen, so he swapped mounts with Yelü Xiuge, keeping the horse that was easy to identify on his own saddle and sending the other man forward on his mount. Yelü Xiuge was the real fighting commander of the Liao side. He first deployed to the east of the pass, led his troops in person against the Song sortie that tried to break out of the pass, and slew the garrison commander Zhang Shi. He then took his elite horse across the Yishui, routed the Song army, pursued it as far as the borders of Mozhou, and took a number of Song officers prisoner. Xiao Gan and Yelü Hede held the camp and beat off a night attack by the Song garrison. On the other side, the reaction of Emperor Song Zhao Guangyi can only be called passive: he intended to tour the frontier at Xiongzhou but never went, and it was only after a report came in that the Song had routed more than ten thousand Liao men and killed over three thousand that he issued the order to tour the border and sent Cui Yanjin to command the armies south of the pass. Later he transferred Yang Ye, the old general who had made the Liao army flinch at the Battle of Yanmen, to be inspector of Yunzhou, while the plan to press on to Youzhou was talked out of him by the Hanlin scholars Li Fang and Hu Meng. Zhang Shi, commander of Waqiao Pass, is the only Song officer whose name survives in the record; he tried to break out of the pass for help and was cut down in the fighting east of the wall.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio），不會出現在瓦橋關的城頭上；它在這一戰的位置，是作為「以絞緊的筋弦蓄力、單發一具重箭」這一類投射技術的代表而存在。扭力弩砲由羅馬人用於拆毀希臘人的城牆與據點，其戰術性格是定點、單發、瞄準某一處城堞或火位，一發之後要重新絞弦上膛，射速遠不如弓，卻能在數百步外壓住城頭或打穿固定目標。瓦橋關實際交手的器械是它的東方對應物：宋軍守關以弓弩為骨幹，蹶張弓、霹靂弓一類強弓與床子弩配置於城頭，另有拋石機一類器具自城內壓制逼近的人馬；關城為夯土城垣，靠門閂、拒馬、鹿角與壕溝禦守，堡寨沿拒馬河串成一線。攻城一方是遼軍，配備以契丹騎兵為主，步卒穴地、攀牆，雲梯、撞竿一類攻城具隨軍攜行，然史籍對其攻城器械的細節記載甚少，未見機械投射重器的確證。北宋邊防的致命弱點正在於此：三關之地平原開闊，遼人可以選擇進攻的方向與時機，宋軍卻只能倚賴城牆的射界；遼軍也沒有羅馬式的扭力投射器，其破關仍靠人馬與簡單器械，僅在戰術配合上取勝。
kitsEn: The Roman torsion bolt-thrower on the card, the Scorpio, never stood on the walls of Waqiao Pass. Its place in this battle is as the representative of a whole class of projecting machines: power stored in tightly twisted sinew, one heavy bolt per shot. The Romans used such engines to break down Greek walls and strongholds. Its tactical character is that of a fixed, single-shot weapon aimed at one particular parapet or firing position; after every shot the crew had to crank the tension back in and reload, so the rate of fire was far below that of a bow, but from several hundred paces it could pin a battlement or punch through a static target. The machines that actually met each other at Waqiao were the eastern equivalents of the same idea. The Song garrison fought with bows and crossbows as its backbone, with strong bows such as the juzhang bow and the pili bow, together with bed-mounted crossbows, posted on the walls, and with stone-throwing engines inside the fortress to press on troops closing in. The pass was a rammed-earth wall defended by barred gates, wooden barricades, deer-horn abatis and ditches, with a chain of forts strung along the Juma River. The Liao army that came up to the wall was organized around Khitan horse archers, its foot soldiers digging under the ramparts and climbing them, carrying scaling ladders and battering rams with the column; the historical record says little about the detail of their siege equipment, and there is no firm evidence of any heavy mechanical projector. That was precisely Song's fatal weakness on this frontier. The ground around the three passes was open plain, so the Liao could choose both the direction and the moment of attack, while the Song could only rely on the fields of fire of the walls. The Liao had no Roman-style torsion projector either; they took the pass with men and horses and simple tools, and won on tactical coordination alone.
tactics: 遼軍的部署自成一套節奏。耶律賢先在幽州集結，以巫師祭兵神、祭旗鼓一類儀式宣示出師，兵至固安後大軍直撲瓦橋關，采取的是圍而不急攻的打法，把宋軍封在關內，再以遊騎遮斷關外通道，逼宋守軍出來決鬥。宋軍果然以攻代守：守將張師在夜裡派兵襲擊遼軍大營，試圖打亂包圍，卻被蕭干與耶律赫德擊退；此後宋軍再試圖從關內突圍，張師本人被耶律休哥陣斬，關城從此再無出關反擊的力量。三日之後，遼軍轉入進攻前的部署，耶律休哥率軍在關東展開，耶律賢在中軍督戰；又過六日，宋軍列陣易水南岸，遼軍抓住宋軍陣形未固的時機，以精騎強渡河道正面衝擊，一戰即潰，追擊直抵莫州境內。遼軍不攻城、不久圍，僅以騎兵衝鋒完成戰役核心，打法純粹是草原式的高機動作戰。宋軍這邊則亂了節奏：巡邊的詔令遲遲未下，前線報捷與實情不符，關南兵馬直到傳聞捷報送到長垣縣之後才倉促任命督部署。
tacticsEn: The Liao deployment followed a rhythm of its own. Yelü Xian first concentrated the army at Youzhou, using the shaman's sacrifice to the god of war and the rites of the flag and the drums to proclaim the campaign; after reaching Gu'an the host drove straight for Waqiao Pass. The method was to surround without hurrying the assault, sealing the Song inside the walls, while flying columns cut the roads outside the pass and forced the Song command to come out and fight. The Song answered with offense in place of defense. In the night the commander Zhang Shi sent troops against the Liao camp in an attempt to shatter the ring, but Xiao Gan and Yelü Hede beat the raid back. A second attempt was made to break out of the pass from within, and Zhang Shi himself was cut down by Yelü Xiuge, after which the fortress had no strength left to strike outward. Three days later the Liao moved into the deployments that preceded the attack, with Yelü Xiuge's troops deployed east of the pass and Yelü Xian directing the battle from the center. Six days after that the Song drew up in line on the south bank of the Yishui, and the Liao seized the moment while their formation was still loose, forcing the best of their horse across the river in a frontal charge that broke the Song at once and drove them as far as the borders of Mozhou. The Liao neither assaulted the walls nor kept up a long siege; the heart of the campaign was settled by the cavalry charge alone, pure steppe-style mobile war. On the Song side the rhythm fell apart. The order to tour the frontier did not come down in time, the reports from the front did not match the facts, and the commanders of the armies south of the pass were not appointed until the rumour of a great victory had reached Changyuan county.
data: 時間線是這一戰最清楚的部分。遼乾亨二年、北宋太平興國五年，農曆十月二十日前後耶律賢抵達固安，十一月親率大軍合圍瓦橋關，十一月十一日遼軍奪關，同月中旬易水之役宋軍崩敗；十二月初大軍班師抵大名府，十二月耶律賢大宴軍士，加封耶律休哥裕悅。戰事連同追擊，前後約一個月。地理尺度上，瓦橋關在雄縣城西南，地當白洋淀之北、拒馬河（易水）之南，西出可至保定，北接幽州重鎮，東可依大清河入海，南通冀中諸鎮，是宋遼邊界上一個關鍵節點。數字方面必須留意：宋廷接到的捷報稱「宋軍在瓦橋關南擊潰遼軍萬餘人，陣斬三千多」，但同一批記載又寫遼軍生擒多名宋軍將領、追奔至莫州境內，兩者互相矛盾，可信度以傳聞為多，具體人數無法核實；遼軍與宋軍的出動兵力，兩《史》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下確數。此外，後來宋真宗朝由何承矩在瓦橋關一線壅塞九河、積水成泊，形成沿流曲折八百里、寬處達六十里的水上防線，那是此戰之後二十餘年才逐步完成的工程，不能回填到九八〇年。
dataEn: The chronology is the clearest part of this battle. In the second year of QIANheng of the Liao, the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo of Northern Song, around the twentieth day of the tenth month Yelü Xian reached Gu'an; in the eleventh month he personally surrounded Waqiao Pass with his army, and on the eleventh day of that month the Liao took the pass, with the Song collapsing at the Yishui in the same mid-month; the host withdrew in the first days of the twelfth month and reached Daming prefecture, and in the twelfth month Yelü Xian feasted the soldiers and conferred the title of Yuyue upon Yelü Xiuge. The fighting and the pursuit together lasted about a month. In terms of geography, Waqiao Pass lay to the southwest of Xiong county seat, north of Baiyang Lake and south of the Juma River, also called Yishui; westward it led to Baoding, northward to the great garrison of Youzhou, eastward it could join the Daqing River to the sea, and southward it opened onto the towns of the Jizhong plain, which made it a key node on the Song-Liao frontier. On numbers one has to be careful. The report of victory that reached the Song court said that the Song army had routed more than ten thousand Liao men south of Waqiao Pass and killed over three thousand, yet the same body of record states that the Liao took a number of Song officers prisoner and pursued them as far as the borders of Mozhou. The two statements contradict each other, and the tally of the day is best treated as rumor rather than fact; the strength of either army is not given exactly in the two dynastic histories or in the Comprehensive Mirror. It should also be added that the cordon of dikes and marshes across the nine rivers at Waqiao, which in the reign of Song Zhenzong turned the plain into a water barrier winding some eight hundred li and sixty li wide at its broadest, was a work completed gradually more than twenty years after this battle, and cannot be read back into 980.
cause: 把時間往回推，瓦橋關之戰是太平興國四年（979）北伐失敗的直接後果。北宋在同年二月滅北漢，隨即乘勝向燕雲十六州用兵，太宗志在乘契丹新亂收復故地，卻在高梁河一戰中大敗，宋軍主力折損，幽雲之地終成畫餅。遼廷視此為國讎，景宗耶律賢以雪恥為名策動第一次南侵，卻在滿城被宋軍擊潰，十二月雁門之戰又被潘美、楊業率軍挫敗，兩戰皆不能得手，於是第二年再整軍備戰：先流放境內企圖叛亂的宋室宗王以安內心，再以巫師祭兵神、祭旗鼓一類儀式整備軍心，大軍集於幽州。宋廷方面的困局則出在自身：瓦橋、淤口、益津三關雖是北疆藩籬，四周卻是冀中平原，無大山大河可守，只能重兵屯戍；宋太宗對前線將領向來放任，甚至有意借小挫敗削弱宋太祖一系宿將的兵柄，這種政策使邊防在危機時刻缺乏統一而迅速的決策。瓦橋關正是在這樣的背景下被選為突破口：它離幽州最近，退路最短，一旦拿下，河北平原便再無屏障。
causeEn: Looking back, the battle of Waqiao Pass was the direct consequence of the failure of the Northern Song campaigns of 980's predecessor year, 979. In the second month of that year the Song destroyed Northern Han, and then pressed on toward the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun while the empire was still disordered; the emperor meant to recover the lost ground while the Khitan were in disarray, but he was badly beaten at Gaoliang River, the main strength of his army was broken, and Yanyun became a mere plan. The Liao court took this as a national humiliation, and Jingzong Yelü Xian launched a first invasion in the name of wiping it out, but was repulsed by the Song at Mancheng, and in the twelfth month was beaten again at Yanmen by the troops of Pan Mei and Yang Ye. Having won nothing in two campaigns, he set about preparing once more in the following year: first exiling the Song prince in his own territory who was suspected of plotting rebellion in order to settle the interior, then rallying the army with the shaman's sacrifice to the god of war and the rites of the flag and the drums, and gathering the host at Youzhou. The Song side was caught in a difficulty of its own making. The three passes of Waqiao, Yuku and Yijin were the northern bulwark, yet they stood on the flat Jizhong plain with no mountains and no great rivers to hold, so they could only be garrisoned heavily. The emperor was by long habit slack with his commanders in the field, and even willing to use small defeats to reduce the authority of the old generals of the previous reign; a policy like that left the frontier without a single, quick decision at the moment of crisis. In that setting Waqiao Pass was chosen as the point of attack: it was the nearest to Youzhou and the shortest way back for the enemy, and once it fell the Hebei plain would have no barrier left.
impact: 這一役的後果遠不止一座關城。遼軍奪取瓦橋關並追擊至莫州，等於在宋遼邊界上撕開一個缺口，河北平原暴露在契丹騎兵之下，宋朝「三關互援」的藩籬格局被打破，宋太宗不得不承認幽雲之圖暫時無望。遼廷則藉勝勢加封耶律休哥為裕悅，把南京留守的統兵權與戰功更加集中在一人身上，此後十餘年，遼對宋的邊境壓制多出於幽州一線的主動出擊。北宋的調整同樣明顯：十二月改派在雁門之戰中令遼軍心寒的老將楊業出任雲州觀察使，把防禦重點從三關推到雲州；原擬乘遼軍退去之際反攻幽州的計畫，被翰林學士李昉、扈蒙等人勸止，北宋對遼轉入長期守勢。往後看，這種守勢一直延續到宋真宗朝，瓦橋關一線改以壅塞九河、積水成泊的水網防禦配合城寨，形成綿延八百里的水上防線，把沒有山險可恃的冀中平原改造成可恃的水障。制度層面上，此役亦暴露了宋軍情報與通訊的粗疏：前方傳來「陣斬三千餘」的捷報而實情是易水慘敗，說明邊報的核驗與傳遞存在漏洞。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign went far beyond a single pass. The Liao seizure of Waqiao Pass and the pursuit to Mozhou tore a gap in the Song-Liao frontier and laid the Hebei plain open to Khitan horse archers; the structure of the three passes supporting one another was broken, and Emperor Song had to admit that the recovery of Yanyun was not to be looked for. The Liao court made use of the victory to confer the title of Yuyue on Yelü Xiuge, concentrating the command of the Nanjing garrison and the credit of the war more tightly in one man, and for the next decade or more Liao pressure on Song came from deliberate sorties out of the Youzhou line. The Song adjustment was just as visible. In the twelfth month the old general Yang Ye, who had made the Liao army flinch at Yanmen, was moved to be inspector of Yunzhou, shifting the weight of the defence from the three passes forward to Yunzhou; the plan to counterattack Youzhou while the Liao army was withdrawing was talked out of the emperor by the Hanlin scholars Li Fang, Hu Meng and others, and Song turned to a long defensive posture against Liao. That posture was to run on into the reign of Song Zhenzong, when the line at Waqiao was changed to a network of water defences: the nine rivers dammed so that the marshes joined up, working together with the forts, forming a water barrier that wound for eight hundred li and turned a plain with no natural cover into ground that could be relied on. On the institutional side the campaign also exposed how slack Song intelligence and dispatch were: a report of more than three thousand killed arrived from the front when the truth was a rout on the Yishui, which shows a real gap in checking and carrying the news from the frontier.
result: 結果是遼軍取勝：易水南岸一戰，宋軍主力崩潰，多名宋軍將領被生擒，瓦橋關守將張師陣亡，瓦橋關一度落入遼軍之手，宋方在河北門戶上的屏障為之一空。遼軍在得手後並不戀戰深入，十二月初班師回朝，途中回到大名府，耶律賢隨即大宴軍士、加封耶律休哥，以一場邊境勝利收束了兩年來的南征。對北宋而言，這是一場明確的敗仗：宋太宗直到遼軍退去才打算順勢攻幽州，又在李昉、扈蒙的勸說下放棄，軍隊改由崔彥進督關南兵馬、楊業鎮雲州，國策退回防守，爭取燕雲的時間表被推後數十年。瓦橋關此後仍是宋遼拉鋸的前線，兩朝先後在此用兵，關內歸屬隨戰局反覆變動；真正決定燕雲十六州歸屬的，仍是宋太宗雍熙北伐及其後的連串敗績，而非這場規模不大的關城攻防。
resultEn: The outcome was a Liao victory. In the fighting on the south bank of the Yishui the main body of the Song army collapsed, a number of Song officers were taken prisoner, Zhang Shi, the commander of Waqiao Pass, was killed, and the pass itself fell for a time into Liao hands, leaving a hole in the Song shield over the gateway to Hebei. Having gained the day, the Liao did not press on into the interior; the host withdrew in the first days of the twelfth month on its way back to court, reaching Daming prefecture on the way, and Yelü Xian feasted the soldiers and raised Yelü Xioge in rank, closing two years of campaigning with a victory on the frontier. For Northern Song this was a clear defeat. Only after the Liao army had withdrawn did Emperor Song think of pressing on to Youzhou, and he was talked out of it by Li Fang and Hu Meng; the command passed to Cui Yanjin for the armies south of the pass and to Yang Ye for Yunzhou, and the state policy fell back to defense, pushing back by decades the timetable for taking Yanyun. Waqiao Pass remained a contested point on the Song-Liao front, both courts fighting around it in turn and its possession changing with the fortunes of war. What in the end settled the fate of the Sixteen Prefectures was not this modest action over a frontier pass, but the Yongxi northern campaigns of Emperor Song and the run of defeats that followed them.
